methodology.inference_settings: CPU 4 threads, ctx 2048, temperature 0, seed 42, no thinking, 128 max output tokens
methodology.scoring: Strict 1 if correct meaning and explicit output format; semantic 1 if correct meaning despite extra preface, else 0
methodology.manual_review: Model outputs read and adjudicated once by assistant; not independently or blind reviewed
methodology.latency_definition: HTTP chat request round-trip measured after explicit model warmup; model preload/warmup excluded; n=10 per language
methodology.p95_definition: nearest-rank p95; with ten observations equals observed maximum

limits: Ten items per language, one run per model: non-generalizable illustrative measurements.
The content/format first-pass review was not preregistered case-by-case and has not been double-adjudicated.
Only three instruction-following models; LFM3 Base excluded from scored comparison as not post-trained.
No LoRA, latent exchange, RAG, tools or DEC control-plane behavior tested.
Cache/context effects, runtime architecture and GGUF quantization may affect scores.
p95 from n=10 is a maximum and is not a stable production percentile.

selection.rationale: No general DEC base-model selection from only 10 questions per language, one repetition, and one adjudicator.
selection.LFM3_Base_excluded: LFM3-1.7B-Base is not an instruction-tuned checkpoint and must not be fairly scored on these instruct questions.
